system.description: The terrain becomes a siphon, draining energy, stamina and heat. Creatures that begin their turn on this terrain must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they make concentration checks at disadvantage and increases the cost of jutsu they cast by +2. This increases to +4 at 7th level and +6 at 15th level.
